description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the distribution of three categories – Context, Generated Response, and Other – across two conditions: “Ours” and “Standard.” The vertical axis displays the conditions, labeled “Ours” and “Standard” in that order, while the horizontal axis represents percentage values, ranging from 0% to 100% with tick labels at 0%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, and 100%. Each condition is represented by a stacked bar composed of three colored segments. For the “Ours” condition, the blue “Context” segment occupies approximately 60.6% of the bar’s length, the orange “Generated Response” segment occupies approximately 7.7%, and the green “Other” segment fills the remaining portion. In the “Standard” condition, the blue “Context” segment occupies approximately 23.6%, the orange “Generated Response” segment occupies approximately 51.1%, and the green “Other” segment occupies approximately 25.3%. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized. A legend at the bottom of the chart indicates that blue represents “Context,” orange represents “Generated Response,” and green represents “Other.”
